outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a single representative deconvoluted mass spectrum (with annotated peak masses/intensities) illustrating cadmium binding to PacL1; it is not a quantified/replicated dataset requiring an n-number.
Panel B is a single representative deconvoluted mass spectrum for PacL1Δ5, analogous to panel A; no replication reporting is expected.

Panel C is a bar chart quantifying the proportion of protein bound to 0-3 Cd atoms for PacL1, PacL1Δ5, and PacL2. Neither the figure legend nor the panel states how many independent measurements/experiments were performed or averaged, nor the replicate type (e.g., biological/technical replicates).
Panel D is a bar chart quantifying Zn-binding proportions for the three proteins; no n-number or replicate type is given in the legend or on the panel.
Panel E is a bar chart quantifying Cu-binding proportions; no information on the number or type of replicates underlying these percentages is provided.
Panel F is a bar chart quantifying Mn-binding proportions; the legend does not state the number of replicate measurements or their type.

replicate_statements: Summary of chemical shift perturbations of PacL1 upon zinc and cadmium interaction at 0.4 (light gray), 1.0 (gray), and 2 (black) equivalents of metal.
outputs.explanation: Panel G presents per-residue NMR chemical shift perturbation values across three metal equivalents but does not report how many independent NMR measurements/samples were used to derive each perturbation value, nor the replicate type.
